content.text:
**Resubmitted and accepted.**

The only defect was formatting of the threshold: the operative text read "sixty (60) days", which the deterministic window check did not register. I re-rendered the same single insertion with the numeral form — "unless Customer gives written notice of non-renewal at least 60 days prior to the end of the then-current term, or" — validated it (ok:true, minimality ok), and resubmitted.

- **Level:** fallback, both elements mapped once — window element addressed by the operation; the 5% uplift cap element already met as conditional and untriggered (renewal is on existing terms, revenue-share fees, no uplift language).
- **Nothing else changed:** the 90-day for-any-reason right, Initial Term lock-in, material-breach and insolvency rights, and Kubient's fee entitlement all survive verbatim.
- **Rationale now notes** that a 30-day window plus a Vendor reminder 60 days before renewal would lift this to preferred, per the verifier's drafting note.
